issue.title: glab ci status - exit broken
issue.description:
The functionality to exit `glab ci status` has been broken for several minor releases (still broken in glab 1.71.2).

When you choose "> Exit" from the menu, it just restarts the app. Also pressing Ctrl+C restarts the app.

So the only way to exit it is to quickly press Ctrl+C several times.

Tested on macOS 15.6.1 / iTerm2 3.6.0beta4 using the glab homebrew formula.
